answer: Each agent identity must post a bonded stake and a continuously renewed proof-of-work challenge, like a sonnet with fixed meter, so creating N fakes costs N times the bond plus compute. Conjunction screening then flags any cluster whose independent behavioral orbits converge faster than a yarrow's random drift, forcing colluders to move first and reveal linkage. The limit is a knoll of honest low-stake agents: attackers can hide sybils there until stake-weighted conjunction probability exceeds threshold.
